items.findings: Author-posted full text, printed pp1327-1328, describes high-suitability areas as mean annual temperature >24 C and annual rainfall >1300 mm; moderate areas 20-24 C and 900-1300 mm. This does not verify Mushtaq's 20-30 C / >1200 mm assertion. These are descriptions of mapped suitability classes, not automatically transferable single-variable response curves.

items.origin: Sanogo et al. (2000), via Yossi et al. (2006)
items.next_action: Retrieve Sanogo thesis and chapter, verify original denominator and whether both reports concern the same respondents; then register and extract through normal provenance checks.
items.runtime_effect: Reported barriers only; no causal effect, cutoff or extra independent source votes.
items.findings: Yossi printed p42 (PDF p48), section 8.7, separately reports labour shortage 31.1%, absent/distant fields 24.6%, planting material 16.8%, time 12%. Denominator and response design are not established there. This supports labour as a reported barrier, not an isolated causal effect, model importance weight or suitability threshold. Yossi attributes this paragraph to Sanogo (2000), while its bibliography lists both a single-author thesis and a four-author chapter; FAO cites Sanogo et al. (2000). Do not assume these identities are interchangeable.
